development_source: The v6 development-only noise-floor artifact, created before any v6 scoring output; v7 preserves the same worlds, splits, normalization and loss.
invalidations: Any change to bins, rate grid, default rate, tie-break, initialization, update order or clipping after scoring output
Any transfer of fitted world weights or hidden world state
Any family label, path, native type, semantic channel name, external model or API
Any evaluator, manifest, preflight or mandatory-baseline mismatch

learner.adaptation: Fresh zero weights per test world; sequential normalized-LMS updates over public support rows using only the frozen learned rate table.
learner.fit: For each assigned source world independently, start zero weights. At each row choose the smallest tied fixed-grid rate minimizing the next visible row squared error, record it by current normalized-innovation bin, then apply that chosen update. Each bin stores the median recorded rate or the default when empty.
learner.prediction: Fifty-step autoregressive linear rollout under the existing tensor contract; non-finite or magnitude above 1e6 fails stability and output is bounded only for schema safety.
learner.source_identity: One module and constants for shared, independent, cross-family-only and support-only; only assigned source data differ.
learner.transferred_state: Six scalar update rates only; no fitted predictor weight, covariance, source example or world hidden state.

success_scope: Both causal gains must exceed the frozen threshold separately in every evaluator-private family and K=4/6/9 cell; no averaging rescues a failed cell. Stability must be 1 and no fixed implementable control may Pareto-dominate the shared learner.
